normalize_text: normalize text by removing control characters and standardizing hyphens, quotes, slashes, and other unicode variants
review_normalize_function: review the normalize function that strips control characters and standardizes unicode punctuation
refactor_normalize_tilde: refactor the normalize function to uncomment and enable tilde character normalization
test_normalize_hyphens: test the normalize function with various unicode hyphen and dash characters
summarize_normalize_constants: summarize the unicode character sets for controls, hyphens, quotes, and slashes used in normalization
